summary.en: QueryPie has developed QEV, a decision-making AI model that achieved a 99.69% sensitive data detection rate in an internal DLP evaluation, reducing missed detections by approximately 91.3% compared with a commercial AI model. INT8 quantization reduced GPU memory usage by up to 45.2% across the QEV model family while broadly maintaining detection performance.

title.en: QueryPie Develops QEV Decision-Making AI Model, Achieving 99.69% Sensitive Data Detection
